blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police are hunting two suspected members of a robbery group who escaped after five of their companions were killed in separate shootouts with law enforcers in Bacoor City, Cavite, on Tuesday afternoon. The two suspects, who reportedly fled on a motorcycle, remain at large, according to a Bacoor police report the Inquirer obtained on Tuesday night. Police said they received intelligence information that armed men were planning to rob a wealthy individual living in a high-end subdivision.
